question: In January 2022, who was named for the Rachael Heyhoe Flint Trophy for ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rachael Heyhoe Flint Trophy for ICC Women’s Cricketer of the Year has been given to Smriti Mandhana (India).
 
• ICC Men’s T20I Cricketer of the Year has been awarded to Mohammad Rizwan (Pakistan).
 
• ICC Women’s T20I Cricketer of the Year has been awarded to Tammy Beaumont (England).
 
• ICC Umpire of the Year has been awarded to Marais Erasmus.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
